title: Fair share: weighted shares of borrowed capacity, and admission fair sharing inside a team
design_ref: Fair share: weighted shares and fairness over time
purpose: A pool queue owns 96 GPUs and runs nothing; research (weight 1) and LLM (weight 2) own none and borrow. Research submits twelve 8-GPU jobs first and takes everything; then LLM submits twelve. Then, inside one team queue with 16 GPUs and usage-based admission fair sharing, a sweep project that has been using the queue competes with a paper project that has not.

checks.description: fair sharing moves the borrowed 96 GPUs to the 2:1 weights: LLM 64, research 32 (within one 8-GPU job)
checks.because: A queue below its weighted share preempts workloads of a queue above it; the strategies stop when shares are as fair as the 8-GPU jobs allow.

checks.description: when capacity frees up, the paper project's job takes one of the two freed slots, ahead of three of the four sweeps queued before it
checks.because: Usage-based admission fair sharing orders pending workloads by their LocalQueue's recent usage, decayed with a 10 min half-life.
